events.text: Thai Oil recruited and nominated Lieutenant General Apichat Chaiyadar to the Audit Committee and the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, Mr. Distat Hotrakitya to the Corporate Governance and Sustainability Committee, and Police Captain Piya Raksakul to the Audit Committee and the Corporate Governance and Sustainability Committee.

Thai Oil recruited and nominated Ms. Pattaralada Sa-ngasang to chairman of the Risk Management Committee and Ms. Peangpanor Boonklum to the Risk Management Committee, ending the office of the Corporate Governance and Sustainability Committee, and Mr. Chadil Chavanalikikorn to the Corporate Governance and Sustainability Committee.

Greenpeace Thailand, in a statement dated 7 June 2025, demanded Thai Oil Public Company Limited take full responsibility for the crude oil spill at SBM-2 (Single Buoy Mooring No. 2) off Si Racha, including environmental restoration and compensation.

Greenpeace Thailand issued a statement on June 6, 2025 urging Thai Oil to take full responsibility for the crude oil spill that occurred at SBM-2 offshore Sriracha, Chonburi on June 5 around 11:54 PM.

On 26 March 2025, an arbitration disclosure document listed Samsung E&A (Thailand), Saipem Singapore, Petrofac South East Asia and PSS Netherlands v. Thai Oil Public Company Limited relating to the Clean Fuel Project.
